product_type: Rear combination lamp: exterior lighting and signalling module combining rear position, stop and reversing lamp functions with an integrated retro-reflector, outer lens and housing
mounting_location: Vehicle rear. The spec does not state the exact position; outboard placement at the rear corners (left and right) is inferred from the drawing callout 'reversing lamp visible to 45° outboard'.

functions.name: rear position lamp (presence/visibility signalling)
functions.description: Emits red light to the rear to indicate the vehicle's presence and width. Drawing callout gives 4 to 17 cd on axis, shaped by the metallised reflector.

functions.name: stop lamp (braking indication)
functions.description: Emits higher-intensity red light to the rear when the service brake is applied. Drawing callout gives 60 to 185 cd on axis from the LED modules on the PCB.

functions.name: reversing lamp (reversing illumination)
functions.description: Illuminates the area behind the vehicle and warns other road users when reverse gear is engaged. Drawing callout requires the lamp to be visible up to 45° outboard.

functions.name: rear retro-reflector (passive conspicuity)
functions.description: Returns incident light from following vehicles' headlamps using moulded prism optics, without needing power. Drawing callout specifies reflectivity at 5° angle of incidence.

functions.name: light transmission and colour definition (outer lens)
functions.description: Red-tinted, UV-stabilised outer lens that transmits the lamp output and sets the signal colour within the chromaticity limits. It also protects and closes the optical unit.

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.role: Closes the lamp, transmits light and defines the red signal colour within chromaticity limits

parts.name: Retro-reflector
parts.role: Passive rear reflex reflector element for conspicuity

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.role: Seals lens to housing to prevent water and dust ingress (no water ingress after spray test)

parts.name: Reflector
parts.role: Optical carrier with multiple cavities that shapes and directs LED light for the rear position, stop and reversing functions

parts.name: LED modules on PCB
parts.role: Light sources for the lamp functions (stop lamp 60 to 185 cd on axis) and electrical carrier

parts.name: Housing
parts.role: Main structural body carrying all internal components and providing the mounting points to the vehicle body

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.role: Attach the lamp to the vehicle and keep it aimed under vibration

electronics: LED light sources (array of LED modules) for the stop lamp function
LED light sources for the rear position lamp and reversing lamp functions (spec states LED modules on PCB as the light source)
Printed circuit board carrying the LEDs
Electrical connector/terminal block on the PCB, inferred from the drawing (striped element), for the vehicle wiring harness connection
vehicle_interfaces: Mechanical attachment to the rear vehicle body by three threaded fasteners/studs projecting from the housing rear (drawing), using the housing mounting bosses
Electrical connection to the vehicle wiring harness via a PCB connector, switched by the lighting switch (position), brake signal (stop) and reverse gear signal (reversing)
Perimeter seal between lens and housing; possibly also a body-side interface
drawing_observations: The outer lens shows a separate rectangular window region at its upper outboard end, distinct from the main lens area, likely the reversing lamp or retro-reflector viewing zone.
The retro-reflector is drawn as a separate prism-pattern insert placed between the outer lens and the seal.
The reflector is segmented: rows of circular LED cavities (likely stop/position), a separate rectangular cavity and a grid-type optical section, indicating separate optical chambers per function.
The PCB carries a dense LED array in rows plus a separate larger square component (possibly the reversing lamp LED or a light-source module) and a striped connector-like element.
The housing shows four corner bosses/holes for internal assembly of the PCB/reflector stack.
Three fasteners (screw/stud type) are shown for vehicle mounting; the spec allows clips too.
The spec does not list a seal, PCB, reflector, housing or fasteners as main parts, but the drawing and materials table include them.
Drawing callouts are requirement statements, not part descriptions; some are attached to unrelated parts (e.g. the reversing lamp 45° outboard visibility callout points to the housing).
uncertainties: How the reversing lamp produces white light given a red-tinted lens: a clear/white lens section or separate window is likely, given the distinct lens region in the drawing, but the spec does not state it.
Exact mounting location (body-side vs. tailgate/split lamp, left/right pair) is not stated in the spec.
Whether the rear position and stop functions share the same LEDs at different intensities or use separate LED groups is not stated.
Presence of driver electronics on the PCB (resistors, current regulation, failure monitoring) and the connector type are not specified.
Materials are stated as representative values with alternatives (housing PP or ASA/PC, seal TPE or silicone, fasteners PA/POM/steel); final choices await the actual bill of materials.
Whether the retro-reflector is a separate insert or moulded into the outer lens; the drawing shows a separate part.
Lamp dimensions, lit areas and mounting height/position on the vehicle are not given.
